g.text: The paying brand's share rose more among paid physicians than matched comparisons

g.text: Brand's share of the physician's GLP-1 claims before and after the first payment, paid vs matched comparison physicians

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Physicians prescribing GLP-1s in both years, first-payment cohorts with two follow-up years; comparison physicians not yet paid by then, matched on prior brand prescribing, GLP-1 volume

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: and growth, diabetes workload, specialty and state. Mounjaro: share relative to its launch. Two years after is the latest year observed for Mounjaro's 2022 cohort. Victoza is the

text.style: font-size: 7.41px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica Neue', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: exception: its share was already falling before payment. Associations, not proof that payments changed prescribing.
